title: FOOD-005F - Provider-neutral electronic payment confirmation boundary
purpose: Represent immutable provider-neutral server-confirmed electronic payment evidence against an exact FOOD-005E physical-order version without manufacturing paid-in-full order truth, dispatch authority, settlement truth or provider integration.

decisions.paymentFact: FOOD-005F records a caller-supplied assertion that a trusted server-side/provider verification confirmed an electronic payment reference and amount. The pure domain validates structure and exact order binding; it cannot authenticate a processor, webhook or source.
decisions.providerNeutrality: No processor is selected by this slice. Processor identity is opaque bounded text. Stripe remains neither assumed nor activated.
decisions.orderBinding: Every confirmation binds one exact FOOD-005E physical-order ID/version and copies that order version's immutable merchandise subtotal as historical context.
decisions.amount: confirmedAmount is the amount reported by the confirmed electronic payment evidence. It is canonical FoodMoney but is not required to equal the order merchandise subtotal.
decisions.payableTotalBoundary: Merchandise subtotal is not final payable total. Tax, discounts, delivery fees, tips and other charges remain unresolved, so FOOD-005F cannot assert paid-in-full from amount equality or manufacture grandTotal/amountDue.
decisions.successPageBoundary: Browser navigation, checkout success pages and client-supplied success flags are non-authoritative and are not fields in this domain.
decisions.authorizationBoundary: Payment authorization and payment confirmation/capture are not conflated. Authorization records are deferred.
decisions.orderMutationBoundary: Payment confirmation never reprices, revises or mutates FOOD-005E order merchandise/fulfillment truth.
decisions.cancelledOrderBoundary: A late or out-of-order confirmation may be recorded against an exact cancelled order version because the confirmation is evidence, not permission to dispatch or revive the order.
decisions.dispatchBoundary: A later trusted paid-order decision may unlock dispatch only after authoritative payable-total construction, exact payment reconciliation and any other required readiness/reservation gates.
decisions.cashBoundary: Cash is separate from electronic processor confirmation and is deferred to later sales/accounting records.
decisions.refundBoundary: Refund, partial refund, chargeback, dispute, reversal, settlement and payout facts are separate later records.
decisions.idempotencyBoundary: Durable uniqueness of processor references, duplicate/out-of-order provider-event handling, webhook signature verification and atomic persistence belong to later trusted service/persistence slices.

FoodElectronicPaymentConfirmationVersion: exact order snapshot { id, version, merchandiseSubtotal }
evidence { channel, processor, processorPaymentReference, confirmationSourceReference, confirmedAmount }

invariants: later order revisions do not retarget historical confirmation
later pricing changes do not mutate confirmation history

future.paidOrderDecision: A later trusted service can combine exact order truth, authoritative payable total and trusted payment confirmation to decide paid-in-full status without mutating historical order merchandise truth.
future.FOOD-005H: Labels, barcode, QR and reorder foundations.

operations: Exactly three local files only. No staging, commit, push, processor connection, secrets, persistence, production access or deployment.
